description: This Java class implements the CriteriaFactory interface, providing methods for creating various criteria and predicates used in query construction within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating logical combinations (and, or, nor), field-based criteria, existence criteria, and comparison predicates such as eq, ne, gt, ge, lt, le, like, and in.

classes.name: CriteriaFactoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the CriteriaFactory interface, providing methods for creating query criteria and predicates.

methods.name: any
methods.description: Returns a singleton Criteria instance representing any criteria.

methods.name: and
methods.description: Creates an 'and' composite criteria from a list of criteria.

methods.name: or
methods.description: Creates an 'or' composite criteria from a list of criteria.

methods.name: nor
methods.description: Creates a 'nor' (not or) composite criteria from a list of criteria.

methods.name: fieldCriteria
methods.description: Creates criteria based on field expressions and predicates.

methods.name: existsCriteria
methods.description: Creates criteria to check for the existence of a field.

methods.name: like
methods.description: Creates a 'like' predicate for string matching.

methods.name: in
methods.description: Creates an 'in' predicate for a list of values.
